title: Sister Act
tagline: The convent choir just got soul. So did the kitchen.
about: A Reno lounge singer hides from the mob in a San Francisco convent and turns the choir around.

St. Katherine's Convent KitchenSister ActThe convent choir just got soul. So did the kitchen.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersReno lounge stuffed mushroomsButton mushrooms stuffed with bacon, garlic, breadcrumbs and parmesanHow to make it20 button mushrooms2 rashers of bacon1 clove garlic1/2 cup breadcrumbs50g parmesan, gratedRemove the stems from the mushrooms and chop the stems.Fry the stems with diced bacon and crushed garlic.Mix with breadcrumbs and parmesan.Fill the caps.Bake at 200°C until golden.Choir practice cheese sconesCheddar and chive scones with a pinch of cayenne, served warmHow to make it450g self-raising flour60g butter, plus extra to serve150g vintage cheddar, grated1 small bunch chives1 pinch cayenne pepper300ml full cream milkRub the butter into the flour, then stir in cheddar, chives and cayenne.Mix in the milk to a soft dough.Pat out and cut into rounds.Bake at 220°C until risen and golden.Serve warm with butter.MainsMary Clarence's convent stew, spiced upBeef stew with smoked paprika, tomato and a splash of hot sauceHow to make it1kg beef chuck, diced2 brown onions4 cloves of garlic1 tbsp smoked paprika1 tsp dried thyme750ml beef stock400g can tomatoes1 tsp hot sauce800g potatoes3 carrotsBrown the beef in batches.Add the onions, garlic, paprika and thyme and cook until soft.Pour in the stock, tomatoes and hot sauce.Braise covered at 150°C.Chop the potatoes and carrots.Add the potatoes and carrots and braise until tender.Late night bar cheeseburgers and friesThe nuns sneaking into the bar across the roadHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thick chuck patties grilled to medium with melted cheddar, onion, lettuce, pickles and burger sauce on a toasted bun, with crisp double-fried chips.Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140°C for 6 minutes, then at 190°C until crisp.Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 thick patties and season.Grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar for the last minute.Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp chopped pickles.Build on toasted buns with lettuce, onion and pickles.SweetsSt Katherine's bread and butter puddingWhite bread layered with sultanas and baked in vanilla custardHow to make it8 slices of white bread50g butter80g sultanas3 eggs500ml full cream milk100ml thickened cream70g caster sugar1 tsp vanilla extract1 tsp ground nutmegButter the bread, cut into triangles and layer in a dish with sultanas.Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, sugar and vanilla and pour over.Soak for 20 minutes.Sprinkle with nutmeg.Bake at 170°C until puffed and golden.DrinksChoir practice honey ginger lemon teaHot black tea with fresh ginger, cinnamon, lemon and honeyHow to make it5 cm knobs of ginger1.2 L water1 cinnamon stick4 black tea bags2 lemons4 tbsp honeySlice the ginger.Simmer the ginger in water with the cinnamon stick.Turn off the heat, add the tea bags and steep, then remove the bags.Stir in the lemon juice and honey.Pour into white cups and float a thin lemon slice in each.
